evidence_type: new official registry protocol, no results
denominator_limit: Top-line 95 versus detailed 85 adolescent enrollment. Caregivers are mentioned, but the registry does not explicitly reconcile the 10-person difference. Do not call all 95 randomized adolescents.
pilot_design: Randomized 1:1 PRISM plus usual care versus usual care with matched study check-ins; outcome assessor blinded.
primary_endpoints: Feasibility, not definitive tic efficacy: at least 12/15 completion in open phase; mean FIM >=4 in intervention arm of randomized pilot.
secondary_domains: Resilience, tic severity and separate impairment, co-occurring symptoms and functioning. Planned repeated assessments through 26 weeks in pilot.
clinical_claim: Protocol only. No proven benefit, adult applicability, recruitment invitation or treatment recommendation.
